en.memoria.10001.name: Shopping with the Three of Them
en.memoria.10001.quote: Yay♪ Then I won't hold back! A parfait shop, pancakes, a steakhouse... I'm going to all of them!
en.memoria.10002.name: Memories of a Group Photo
en.memoria.10002.quote:
Oh, right, that reminds me. Let me show you something nice.
This is a photo we had taken right after we formed. See, see? Isn't it cute?
en.memoria.10003.name: How to Stop the Brutal Training?
en.memoria.10003.quote:
Mmm, you're sooo soft~, squish squish squish~.
Kyah! Nn, uuu...! Ch-Chiyuru-san...
en.memoria.10004.name: The Bonds of Pre-Class A
en.memoria.10004.quote: We did it, we did it! We won! We really won! Yeah! Everyone worked so hard! We did it! I'm so glad I'm on this team!
en.memoria.10005.name: Where the Misunderstanding Leads
en.memoria.10005.quote: ...An explanation... No, it's not an ordinary haunted house. It's a House of Terror. Heart-pounding, a little hardcore, and with a shock at the very end.
en.memoria.10006.name: Cooking and Girl Talk for Two
en.memoria.10006.quote:
I'll feed you! Here, this one! Say "ahh"!
Wh-whoa! S-Sumika-san, you're so bold...! Feeding someone like that...!
en.memoria.10007.name: Helping-Out Stroll
en.memoria.10007.quote:
I want to help with everyone's wishes
and make them smile. Everyone's smiles feel so warm and cozy.
en.memoria.10008.name: Cuilan Is Julia's...
en.memoria.10008.quote:
...I'm fine...
However... how long do you intend to keep groping, you pervert?
en.memoria.10009.name: Year-End Reflections
en.memoria.10009.quote:
Heh... I rarely go to karaoke with anyone.
It came back to me, and I found myself stopping in my tracks.
en.memoria.10010.name: Christmas Surprise♪
en.memoria.10010.quote:
Cuilan-chan said a present for the Commander should be the thing you most want to give!
So I'm giving you me~♪
en.memoria.10011.name: The Past That Led to Chaos
en.memoria.10011.quote:
This team, Chaos Maiden... before I knew it,
it had become a precious place that accepts me even knowing who I am.
en.memoria.10012.name: Visiting the Places of a You I Never Knew
en.memoria.10012.quote:
Instead of having everyone learn everything at once,
I'll show everyone the "real" me of today, little by little—
en.memoria.10013.name: The Snowy Mountain's Other Rumor
en.memoria.10013.quote:
There are still so many sights I have yet to see.
When that time comes... well, might I accompany you?
en.memoria.10014.name: Proof of Effort
en.memoria.10014.quote:
Because you judged that I have the ability
worthy of Arcturus.
en.memoria.10015.name: Something Tugging at Her Memory
en.memoria.10015.quote:
I'd like to know more about MGs.
They're very similar to Tactical Surface Fighters, but there seem to be plenty of differences.
en.memoria.10016.name: Klutzy Committee Chair
en.memoria.10016.quote:
I really am hopeless, aren't I...
I meant to help someone, and I ended up being the one who needed helping...
en.memoria.10017.name: Live Mode
en.memoria.10017.quote:
Yes, this is far better than I imagined.
Each of you shows your own personality, and it suits you all very well.
en.memoria.10018.name: 3000x Sensitivity Slippery Sumo
en.memoria.10018.quote: "3000x Sensitivity Slippery Lotion" on sale now! Born from the antics of two girls who met in the sea of the internet, this new product is best tried in a maidens' sumo bout.
en.memoria.10019.name: The Maid Detectives Chase an Academy Mystery
en.memoria.10019.quote:
Hyaah! Got you, you crook!
Give back what you stole from everyone!
en.memoria.10020.name: Even If I Pile Lies on My Loneliness
en.memoria.10020.quote:
If I win, how about you whisper "I love you" in my ear,
with all your heart!
en.memoria.10021.name: Come, Let Me Pamper You
en.memoria.10021.quote:
Everyone demands far too much of you, dear.
No one will fault you for resting now and then.
en.memoria.10022.name: If It's Shared with You
en.memoria.10023.name: Inter-Academy Mahjong Tournament
en.memoria.10023.quote: The tournament is for pairs! I'll do the winning, so you just sit there!
en.memoria.10024.name: Most Wanted: "Dark Drug"
en.memoria.10024.quote: Mao: "Carina! Here's the composite sketch!" Carina: "...Nice one, Chair~!"
en.memoria.10025.name: The Unknown Her of an Unknown World
en.memoria.10025.quote: I hardly ever wear stuff like this, so you'd better burn it into your eyes while you can~?
en.memoria.10026.name: A Secret from Zina
en.memoria.10026.quote: Wha—!? Are you still angry about being dragged in earlier!? Elena shares the blame for always being where I ran to...!
en.memoria.10027.name: Dieting for Someone Else
en.memoria.10027.quote: The grilled squid is rich and tasty too...! This chewiness is irresisti— ah, it's already gone...!?
en.memoria.10028.name: I Tried a Beach Date♪
en.memoria.10028.quote: I'm here for the water sports tournament, but there's a bit of a wait, so I'll tour the beach huts and show you their top picks~!
en.memoria.10029.name: From the Me Who Was Once a Child
en.memoria.10029.quote:
Wah, waah!? Hey, you can't both pull at the same time!?
Sensei, I'll get torn in two!
en.memoria.20001.name: A Study Session for Two
en.memoria.20001.quote: Um... I... I've been wondering if there's something more I can do for everyone in Sirius Sugar...
en.memoria.20002.name: A World I've Yet to Know
en.memoria.20002.quote:
If I will do, I'd be delighted.
Allow me to explain how to care for flowers, from the very basics.
en.memoria.20003.name: Stay the Way You Are
en.memoria.20003.quote: Whoa, that's such a waste! Come play outside with me! Yep, let's do that, it's decided!
en.memoria.20004.name: Moneymaking and Punishment
en.memoria.20004.quote:
A cute girl is counting on you, how lucky are you!
...So! Are you coming with me!? Or not!?
en.memoria.20005.name: The Me I Want You to Know
en.memoria.20005.quote:
I like silver things. They're cute.
It's a calm color... and it goes with my hair, too.
en.memoria.20006.name: Strictness and Kindness
en.memoria.20006.quote:
Some people hate me and speak ill of me.
But if being the villain lets me protect everyone, I'll gladly be hated as much as it takes.
en.memoria.20007.name: The Praise-Hungry Type
en.memoria.20007.quote:
Ah... h-h-hello! I-I've been waiting for you!!
I thought if I waited outside your room, you'd come out eventually...
en.memoria.20008.name: Plan Your Gratitude Wisely
en.memoria.20008.quote:
Shaddaaap!! Don't say that name!!
Did you look inside my planner!? Did you or didn't you!?
en.memoria.20009.name: The Best Me I Want to Show
en.memoria.20009.quote:
H-hey! What are you laughing at!?
I-I'll wipe that grin off your face someday, just you wait!
en.memoria.20010.name: A Date, My Way
en.memoria.20010.quote: Hearing it all at once would be a waste, right? ...So I'll ask you on another date someday. Tell me the rest then, nice and slow, okay?
en.memoria.20011.name: Your Dangerous Feelings
en.memoria.20011.quote:
These air guns are all the rage right now!
You move around a lot, so it's good training for piloting too.
en.memoria.20012.name: The Pillar of Chaos Maiden
en.memoria.20012.quote:
Honestly... you're hopeless.
I'll show you to the exit, so please follow me.
en.memoria.20013.name: Facing My True Nature
en.memoria.20013.quote: I must control it even more! This pleasure! This thrill! This elation! So I can make it even more my own!
en.memoria.20014.name: Where Do Feelings Live?
en.memoria.20014.quote:
I saw it in the shopping district and thought it was the thing I wanted most.
I usually buy things myself, but having someone buy it for me feels special.
en.memoria.20015.name: A Lesson for the Troublemaker
en.memoria.20015.quote:
Please... don't go away...!
Don't leave me behind... don't leave me all alone...!
en.memoria.20016.name: Beyond the Limit
en.memoria.20016.quote:
Mmh... nn... zzz, zzz...
I'll borrow your bed. I can feel safe here.
en.memoria.20017.name: Fl∞ty's "Poyo"
en.memoria.20017.quote:
I hate lame behavior, and my friends mean the world to me...
and I just love that free gal vibe nothing can tie down!
en.memoria.20018.name: Energy-Saving, Cost-Performance First
en.memoria.20018.quote:
I'm not red! I-it's the sunset! Blame the sunset!
Ugh... this is... such bad... cost performance...
en.memoria.20019.name: What I Really Want to Do
en.memoria.20019.quote:
I'm going to give it my all at this academy. Because I can make my friends and all kinds of people smile...
Look forward to it, okay? Someday I'll sing for you, Commander.
en.memoria.20020.name: Your Secret I Want to Know
en.memoria.20020.quote:
Fashion like this is my hobby, you see♪
I'll put together a proper look for you.
en.memoria.20021.name: Rosie the Fantasy Sculptor
en.memoria.20021.quote: C'mon, hur-ry-up. Never mind, never mind, let's hurry back to the room. Giddy-up, Kouhai-kun!
en.memoria.20022.name: Noblesse Oblige
en.memoria.20022.quote: The clothes at this shop are wonderful! Look, every one is so cute...! Fufu, just looking at them makes my heart dance.
en.memoria.20023.name: What a Maid Should Be
en.memoria.20023.quote:
Haha, doesn't sound like me, huh? Fretting like this.
Sorry for letting you see me so pathetic.
en.memoria.20024.name: What a Hero Needs!
en.memoria.20024.quote:
Fighting can't be helped. Even Lilly does it.
But hitting and punching is wrong!
en.memoria.20025.name: The Me I Should Be, the Me I Want to Be
en.memoria.20025.quote:
To be won over by someone yet again...
Perhaps I have no talent for being a spy.
en.memoria.20026.name: For Everyone's Sake
en.memoria.20026.quote: —Gotcha! Huh? I was sure you were here... Hey, where are you~!? Come o~n!
en.memoria.20027.name: Who I Am Now
en.memoria.20027.quote:
That's it, that's it. Run like that and you'll get less tired.
If there's anything you don't get, you can ask me as many times as you like.
en.memoria.20028.name: A Heartfelt Thank You
en.memoria.20028.quote: To the Commander, who always looks after us: a delivery of gratitude! Here's to many more years together♪
en.memoria.20029.name: Poyo-Packed♥ Vampire Gal
en.memoria.20029.quote: I-I'm only changing clothes, so nothing that drastic is going to happen!
en.memoria.20030.name: The Jiangshi Girl Won't Move
en.memoria.20030.quote: Huh? That's right. That's why I brought all my materials and tools onto the bed.
en.memoria.20031.name: A Diary for Two
en.memoria.20031.quote:
Relaxing like this is nice too... being with everyone is great, of course.
But I'd like it to be just the two of us again, Takeru-chan.
en.memoria.20032.name: Memories We Search for Together
en.memoria.20032.quote:
The view from here... is peace itself.
I do not know this scenery... and yet I feel as if I fought in pursuit of it.
en.memoria.20033.name: Something We Can Do Together
en.memoria.20033.quote: Huh? ...This is the plushie they were selling at the variety store...! Takeru-san... this... are you sure? For me to have it...
en.memoria.20034.name: Reivel's Stand-In Manager
en.memoria.20034.quote:
I handle basic hair styling and makeup myself.
I make a point of doing what I can on my own.
en.memoria.20035.name: Operation: Diet for Two!
en.memoria.20035.quote:
Mmm... munch munch...
Ehehe... yummy... I can't... eat any more...
en.memoria.20036.name: A Special Feeling
en.memoria.20036.quote:
Nothing but stars and the moon.
...But the night sky, seen together by the six of us, feels special. A little different.
en.memoria.20037.name: We Haven't Had a Pillow Fight Yet!
en.memoria.20037.quote:
Fee-chan, let's settle this~~~~!!
...Just kidding, take that, Anis-chan!
en.memoria.20038.name: Sharing a Snow-Lit Night
en.memoria.20038.quote:
Sneaking off to have you all to myself isn't fair, but...
at least for this moment right now, it's okay, right...?
en.memoria.20039.name: Like a Flickering Flame
en.memoria.20039.quote:
...It really is beautiful. A candle flickering in the pitch dark.
It's reassuring... or rather, calming.
en.memoria.20040.name: Twisted Gratitude
en.memoria.20040.quote:
A weakling like you can't do a thing without Rami around.
Fine, whatever... I'll let you stick with me from now on too.
en.memoria.20041.name: "Love"
en.memoria.20041.quote:
Feels all fuzzy...
Onii-chan's head pats are Lydia's number one.
en.memoria.20042.name: Rami's Siblings Visit the Academy
en.memoria.20042.quote:
Okaaay, you two, that's enough.
No fighting in the street. There are other people walking here, you know?
en.memoria.20043.name: Something New Year-ish → Let's Have a Mochi Party♪
en.memoria.20043.quote:
Hey, hey, more importantly, how is it? Does it suit me?
Really? You're not tired of seeing it?
en.memoria.20044.name: Having a Blast on the Snowy Mountain!
en.memoria.20044.quote:
Wh-why~!? I practice properly,
and I train all the time too... owwwwww!?
en.memoria.20045.name: Fever, Humidity, and Nursing
en.memoria.20045.quote:
As a big sister... I want to show my little brother and sister
how cool I can be.
en.memoria.20046.name: A Brief Breather
en.memoria.20046.quote:
I've never seen a noodle dish like this.
Just looking at it makes me excited!
en.memoria.20047.name: Lucie's Landing
en.memoria.20047.quote:
...Haah, honestly.
I'll look after you until you don't need me anymore.
en.memoria.20048.name: Stride of Remembrance
en.memoria.20048.quote:
Wake up, Shirogane!
It's long past the time we agreed on!
en.memoria.20049.name: A Continue for Two
en.memoria.20049.quote:
Takeru's going to be amazed too! Okay, watch!
First you pass the string from back to front like this...
en.memoria.20050.name: Yakisoba Bread Rhapsody
en.memoria.20050.quote: Great as field rations too. Tasty even cold. Perfect.
en.memoria.20051.name: Our Joint Effort
en.memoria.20051.quote:
In a way, this outfit is more embarrassing than being naked,
so at first I was shocked and thought it had to be a mistake...
en.memoria.20052.name: I'm All Right Now
en.memoria.20052.quote:
In real combat, there's no time to hesitate...
I have to learn to use it well while I still can.
en.memoria.20053.name: Clumsy Kindness
en.memoria.20053.quote:
You have nowhere to go, right?
Then I'll make a "place to go" for you.
en.memoria.20054.name: My First Selfish Wish
en.memoria.20054.quote:
That's the first time I've ever asked for something selfish.
I guess I really could have said it sooner, couldn't I...?
en.memoria.20055.name: A Hurdle to Clear
en.memoria.20055.quote:
...Just like Justion changed Lilly,
I want to lead that person somewhere better.
en.memoria.20056.name: A Rule-Breaking Illustration
en.memoria.20056.quote:
Carina: "You're good at drawing~. So this is how people see me and the Chair, huh."
Mao: "Lewd things are a rule violation! Wait, why are you uploading it without asking!?"
en.memoria.20057.name: Pico Wrote It Up Neatly!
en.memoria.20057.quote: Master! I wrote it up neatly for you~!
en.memoria.20058.name: The Vice-Chair's Real Self?
en.memoria.20058.quote:
Most of the time, you slack off pro-per-ly,
and when it counts you go bam and shine. That's good enough.
en.memoria.20059.name: The Forgotten Words That Started It All
en.memoria.20059.quote:
I-I'm sorry! For causing you trouble...
Um, if you move around too much... th-that's...
en.memoria.20060.name: Betting My Feelings
en.memoria.20060.quote:
If the alternative is causing you trouble,
I'll take on a match like this myself.
en.memoria.20061.name: The Lost Little Bunny
en.memoria.20061.quote:
We didn't both need to squeeze into
the same locker, did we...
en.memoria.20062.name: With Father...
en.memoria.20062.quote:
Um... well... that is...
...I'm sorry. I couldn't talk much.
en.memoria.20063.name: Bear-Eared Mother and Beloved Daughter
en.memoria.20063.quote:
At my daughter's request, I've transformed into "Grizzly Moon."
—In the name of the bear, I'll punish you.
en.memoria.20064.name: A Nervous Performance
en.memoria.20064.quote:
Right now, I'm not Harriet...
I'm not Harriet, so there's nothing to be embarrassed about...
en.memoria.20065.name: Because I Don't Want Any Regrets
en.memoria.20065.quote:
I don't want any regrets! Kay and Harry.
I don't want to leave anything undone with the friends who've become so dear to me!
en.memoria.20066.name: Someday, I'll Be Your Sword
en.memoria.20066.quote:
"Upon this sword, I shall strike down all that would harm you.
Upon this heart, I shall remain at your side."
en.memoria.20067.name: Overlaid with Memories
en.memoria.20067.quote: Ah, oh, no... my apologies. I'm not used to... the product names of this world.
en.memoria.20068.name: My Day as a Proper Young Lady
en.memoria.20068.quote: What do you mean, "loud"!? I just... changed my mind a little, that's all!
en.memoria.20069.name: A Dreamlike Ending
en.memoria.20069.quote: Behave yourself. ...I don't want to get any rougher than this.
en.memoria.20070.name: The Violator's Selfie
en.memoria.20071.name: The Hardworking Class Rep
en.memoria.20071.quote:
The class rep always works so hard, and never slacks off...
I'll definitely help you out, Class Rep―――
en.memoria.20072.name: Violence Comes Without Warning.
en.memoria.20072.quote: It was――― a merciless blow. Her charm is infinite.
en.memoria.20073.name: Captivated by a Side I'd Never Seen
en.memoria.20073.quote: P-please stop! Bringing up embarrassing stories from so long ago that even I don't remember them!
en.memoria.20074.name: As Long As I'm Dancing with You
en.memoria.20074.quote: Fufu... dancing isn't a contest, so there's no winning or losing, you know?
en.memoria.20075.name: Let Us Pamper Each Other
en.memoria.20075.quote: You did well... I was watching over you the whole time, dear one...
en.memoria.20076.name: You, Who See Me
en.memoria.20076.quote: Phew... my, my, you're really stiff, customer♪ Rock solid! Now this is worth showing off my skills!
en.memoria.20077.name: With Kindness in Her Eyes
en.memoria.20077.quote: ...So, Carina, I'll leave the rest to you. No more slacking off, okay?
en.memoria.20078.name: Reaching for the Radiance
en.memoria.20078.quote: Do I... even have the right to be with all of you?
en.memoria.20079.name: Dreaming Is Free
en.memoria.20079.quote: On my next diet, I'll definitely slim down big time...! No, all at once is hard, so maybe the diet after that...
en.memoria.20080.name: My Most Precious Thing
en.memoria.20080.quote: My, just where exactly are you planning to touch? How sca~ry... fufu♪
en.memoria.20081.name: Even on a Day Full of Trouble
en.memoria.20081.quote: Wa-wa-wa, what do I... do!? Ah, ah... eh!? Aaaaah~~~!?
en.memoria.20082.name: Helping-Out Stroll and a Summer Treasure
en.memoria.20082.quote: Reivel, Luna, Onii-chan... and Lydia. Being all together is surely the best treasure.
en.memoria.20083.name: Coffee, and Memories...
en.memoria.20083.quote:
Wanting this place to stay lively and keep going
is also my way of repaying a kindness♪
en.memoria.20084.name: The Business Circle I Dream Of
en.memoria.20084.quote:
As that circle grows, in the end everyone is smiling...
That kind of business is my dream.
en.memoria.20085.name: So We All Win Together
en.memoria.20085.quote: U-um... I'm fairly sure I hung the "In Use" sign...
en.memoria.20086.name: First Feelings
en.memoria.20086.quote:
Ahaha♪ From here on, I'm getting serious too!
Let's be rivals, everyone!
en.memoria.20087.name: A Glimpse of the Future
en.memoria.20087.quote:
Leave it to me. After all the times I've relied on you,
it's my turn to do my best.
en.memoria.20088.name: Muv-Luv GG Collab Café Celebration!
en.memoria.20088.quote:
Meru: "Welcome, Commander! Please eat lots!"
Rami: "Getting waited on by Rami and the girls? Talk about super lucky. Go on, cry tears of joy~?"
en.memoria.20089.name: Dad's Wish, and Mine
en.memoria.20089.quote:
...I told you about my dad earlier, didn't I?
And then, somehow, I started missing having people around.
en.memoria.20090.name: Good Luck Charm
en.memoria.20090.quote:
Wh-whoa whoa!?
Hey! What are you doing all of a sudden, you're messing up my hair!
en.memoria.20091.name: This Moment Is Everything
en.memoria.20091.quote:
Nina: "Um... I thought Zina has been pushing herself too hard lately."
Zina: "I am merely fulfilling my duty as a pilot, and as a warrior."
en.memoria.20092.name: A New Power
en.memoria.20092.quote:
Nadya: "No matter how hard the battle, we can surely overcome it...!"
Olga: "I trust you too. Together, surely we can..."
en.memoria.30001.name: Sirius Sugar
en.memoria.30001.quote: A team of underachievers led by Nanairo Narutaki. When it comes to getting along, they can match even the top teams.
en.memoria.30002.name: Colorful Bouquet
en.memoria.30002.quote: One of the top teams on its campus, led by Aoi Ikoma. Its strength is disciplined teamwork.
en.memoria.30003.name: Chaos Maiden
en.memoria.30003.quote: One of the top teams on its campus, known for a freedom that seems to mirror the personality of its leader, Julia.
en.memoria.30004.name: Pyxis Ma Soeur
en.memoria.30004.quote: One of the finest teams in the academy, led by Dorothea. Its strength is well-coordinated teamwork.
en.memoria.30005.name: Treble Quintet
en.memoria.30005.quote: A team led by Flute. Every member holds another title besides pilot.
en.memoria.30006.name: A Fateful Meeting with the Girls
en.memoria.30006.quote:
U-um, are you all right? I'm glad you've woken up...
...S-so, um... for now, here's a towel.
en.memoria.30007.name: A Hard Warm-Up...?
en.memoria.30007.quote: Nn, ah, haah, haah... nnuuuuu! No, ah, I-I can't... any more...!
en.memoria.30008.name: The Incognito Sister's Adventure
en.memoria.30008.quote: Because I'm too scared to move...! Please, I beg you, stay by my side...!
en.memoria.30009.name: Intriguing Equipment
en.memoria.30009.quote: ...Fufufu... it's all squishy...♪ This is... interesting. Addictive. Don't mind if I do... poke, poke.
en.memoria.30010.name: STRANGERS
en.memoria.30011.name: We Tried a L*wd Punishment Game
en.memoria.30011.quote:
Haah... haah... p-please don't film Flute
looking like this so much~...!
en.memoria.30012.name: Full-Throttle Elopement!
en.memoria.30012.quote:
My, Commander... fufu, how bold of you.
Did you want to see us naked that badly?
en.memoria.30013.name: The Timid Reindeer's Holy Night
en.memoria.30013.quote:
A-a naughty reindeer!?
Wh-wha, no way, th-that's...!
en.memoria.30014.name: Trinity Jewel
en.memoria.30014.quote: A team of gifted members led by Reivel. They regard a three-member lineup as the optimal formation.
en.memoria.30015.name: New Year's at the Momozono House
en.memoria.30015.quote:
Mmm~, Mom's black beans really are the best~!
Mom! Teach me this black bean recipe later!
en.memoria.30016.name: New Year's Greetings
en.memoria.30016.quote:
Happy New Year. I will devote myself to making Zartum Academy even better.
I would be grateful for your continued support this year.
en.memoria.30017.name: Up Close!? Chaos in the Tent
en.memoria.30017.quote:
Ahaha! This might be fun! Come on, come on!
Push, push, no crying if you get squished!
en.memoria.30018.name: Hospitality from Three Maids?
en.memoria.30018.quote:
Don't you "what's going on" me!
You pervert! Brute! Peeping tom! Scoundrel!!
en.memoria.30019.name: Old Rivals Stuck Together?
en.memoria.30019.quote: Sakaki is all health-consciousness and no actual health. Getting angry so easily proves it.
en.memoria.30020.name: Gripes and Worries
en.memoria.30020.quote:
How can you expect perfection in so little time!?
You're sure great at spouting complaints and demands!
en.memoria.30021.name: To You, Who Will Walk with Me from Now On
en.memoria.30021.quote:
Whenever I look back, you're there, Commander... that gives me the most courage.
I'm counting on you from here on, too!
en.memoria.30022.name: A Doze Amid the Bustle
en.memoria.30022.quote:
Photos... go through the staff...
zzz... you're banned...
en.memoria.30023.name: Euro Tower for a Day
en.memoria.30023.quote:
What are you doing!? I never said you could stop!
Three minutes, starting now! Keep doing push-ups until you hit your limit!
en.memoria.30024.name: Disciplinary Committee
en.memoria.30024.quote: A peacekeeping team directly under the student council, made up of students gathered from every campus.
en.memoria.30025.name: Absolute Command Rights!
en.memoria.30025.quote: Come on, place your bets, place your bets! There you go~! Let's keep 'em coming!
en.memoria.30026.name: Chaos Maiden Twintail Festival♡
en.memoria.30026.quote:
Now we all match♪ Let's go show the Commander like this♪
I'm sure he'll praise us in a way that moves us♪
en.memoria.30027.name: Shaping What a Family Looks Like
en.memoria.30027.quote:
Olga: "State your view, keeping in mind the differences between fighting MGs and fighting Maze Shifters."
Nadya: "Y-yes!"
en.memoria.30028.name: The Alley Cat with Panties in Its Mouth
en.memoria.30028.quote:
Haah... if it were just an interview and I didn't actually have to be in the spotlight,
it'd be fine. But a photo shoot, and being in the school magazine...
en.memoria.30029.name: The Color of the Heart
en.memoria.30029.quote: ...I never knew a night without being at Inia's side could be this cold...
en.memoria.30031.name: Etiquette Lessons from a True Young Lady
en.memoria.30031.quote: Who are you calling Mama... Now, Chiyuru-san. Would you raise your hand a little higher?
en.memoria.30032.name: Pico's Always by Your Side♪
en.memoria.30032.quote: Masterrr! This is such a happy occasion! I hope happy things like this keep going fore~ver!
en.memoria.30033.name: A Soothing Scent
en.memoria.30033.quote: I knew it... when Mother is with everyone from Krasna, she seems strict, but somehow she also seems at ease...
en.memoria.30034.name: Why She's in Such High Spirits
en.memoria.30034.quote: Ahaha, at a glance it just looks like string, huh. But it's a proper swimsuit too~
en.memoria.30035.name: Something Friends Would Do
en.memoria.30035.quote:
"Over here, Meru-chan! Let's go, let's go!"
"Wah! Julia-san, please calm down...!"
en.memoria.30036.name: The World Now Draws a New Path
en.memoria.30036.quote:
When they smile afterwards and tell me it felt good,
that alone makes me really happy.
en.memoria.30037.name: To Seize the Future
en.memoria.30037.quote:
The bonds we've woven gather at the final battlefield.
The time has come to overturn our destined fate and break the "Garden."
en.memoria.30038.name: The Greatest Fortune Is...
en.memoria.30038.quote:
Mm... just soaking in the tub
warms my whole body up. It feels so nice...
en.memoria.30040.name: Красна
en.memoria.30040.quote: A team led by Olga. Its coordination is said to surpass every other team's.
en.memoria.30042.name: A Small, Big, Precious Promise
en.memoria.30042.quote:
From now on, too,
please let me make lots of memories by your side.
en.skill.110001.name: Lumina Grace
en.skill.110001.desc.0: Attacks a single enemy with {0} Power and inflicts Stun for 2 actions. If this attack defeats the target, gains 1 AP.
en.skill.110001.desc.1: Removes all debuffs on self, then attacks a single enemy with {0} Power and inflicts Stun for 2 actions. If this attack defeats the target, gains 1 AP.
en.skill.110002.name: One Pitiful Thing a Day
en.skill.110002.desc.0: Attacks all enemies with a 5-hit EN attack of {0} Power. If a critical hit occurs from this attack, inflicts a temporary debuff that increases damage taken by 100% (stackable), then performs 1 more EN attack hit of {0} Power.
en.skill.110003.name: Soft and Melty Feelings
en.skill.110003.desc.0: Attacks all enemies with {0} Power and inflicts a debuff that increases damage taken by {1}% for 2 attacks (stackable). Also inflicts Stun for 1 action on the single enemy with the highest ATK.
en.skill.110004.name: Become My Idea
en.skill.110004.desc.0: Attacks all enemies with {0} Power. Damage increases the more surviving enemies there are (up to +100%).
en.skill.110004.desc.1: Attacks all enemies with {0} Power. Damage increases the more surviving enemies there are (up to +100%). Also grants self an effect that reduces damage taken by {1}% once (stackable).
en.skill.110005.name: Q.E.D.
en.skill.110005.desc.0: Attacks all enemies with {0} Power. If the target has an ailment, inflicts Stun for 1 action.
en.skill.110005.desc.1: Attacks all enemies with {0} Power. If the target has an ailment, inflicts Stun for 1 action and a debuff that increases damage taken by {1}% once (stackable).
en.skill.110006.name: Tongue-Out Tease♡
en.skill.110006.desc.0: Attacks an enemy row with {0} Power and restores own HP by {1}% of the damage dealt.
en.skill.110006.desc.1: Attacks an enemy row with {0} Power and restores own HP by {1}% of the damage dealt. If this attack defeats an enemy, inflicts a debuff on all enemies that increases damage taken by {2}% (stackable).
en.skill.110007.name: Live Streaming!
en.skill.110007.desc.0: Restores all allies' HP by {0}% of Max HP. Also grants additional healing with {1} Power to the ally with the lowest HP%.
en.skill.110008.name: Accept Love
en.skill.110008.desc.0: Attacks the single enemy with the lowest HP% with {0} Power. Also grants all allies a buff that evades 1 hit.
en.skill.110008.desc.1: Attacks the single enemy with the lowest HP% with {0} Power and reduces its AP by 1. Also grants all allies a buff that evades 1 hit.
en.skill.110009.name: Verborgene Gefühle
en.skill.110009.desc.0: Attacks an enemy row with {0} Power and removes all Passive Points the targets currently hold.
en.skill.110009.desc.1: Attacks an enemy row with {0} Power, removes all Passive Points the targets currently hold, and inflicts Stun for 1 action.
en.skill.110010.name: Vivace
en.skill.110010.desc.0: Attacks all enemies with an EN attack of {0} Power, then performs an additional EN attack of {1} Power on the single enemy with the lowest HP%. Also grants self a buff that increases damage dealt on the next attack by 30% (stackable).
en.skill.110011.name: A Maiden's Excitement
en.skill.110011.desc.0: Attacks all enemies with an EN attack of {0} Power and restores own HP by 25% of the damage dealt.
en.skill.110011.desc.1: Attacks all enemies with an EN attack of {0} Power and restores own HP by 25% of the damage dealt. Also inflicts Burn for 3 actions. Burn deals damage over time equal to ATK × 30%.
en.skill.110012.name: Twilight Evening Flame
en.skill.110012.desc.0: Attacks an enemy row with {0} Power, prioritising the back line. Also grants self a Shield that blocks damage equal to Max HP × 50%. The Shield's maximum value decreases by 25% per action.
en.skill.110012.desc.1: Attacks an enemy row with {0} Power, prioritising the back line. Also grants self a Shield that blocks damage equal to Max HP × 60%. The Shield's maximum value decreases by 25% per action.
en.skill.110012.desc.2: Attacks an enemy row with {0} Power, prioritising the back line. Also grants self a Shield that blocks damage equal to Max HP × 70%. The Shield's maximum value decreases by 25% per action.
en.skill.110012.desc.3: Attacks an enemy row with {0} Power, prioritising the back line. Also grants self a Shield that blocks damage equal to Max HP × 80%. The Shield's maximum value decreases by 25% per action.
en.skill.110012.desc.4: Attacks an enemy row with {0} Power, prioritising the back line. Also grants self a Shield that blocks damage equal to Max HP × 90%. The Shield's maximum value decreases by 25% per action.
en.skill.110012.desc.5: Attacks an enemy row with {0} Power, prioritising the back line. Also grants self a Shield that blocks damage equal to Max HP × 100%. The Shield's maximum value decreases by 25% per action.
en.skill.110013.name: Now Then... I'm Ready
en.skill.110013.desc.0: Restores HP of front-line allies with {0} Power and raises their ATK by 10% for 1 action (stackable). Also performs an EN attack of {1} Power on an enemy row.
en.skill.110014.name: The Spirit of Discipline
en.skill.110014.desc.0: Restores own HP by {0}% of Max HP, raises own ATK by 50% for 2 actions (stackable), and grants Stun Nullify.
en.skill.110014.desc.1: Restores own HP by {0}% of Max HP, raises own ATK by 50% for 2 actions (stackable), and grants Stun Nullify. Also grants self a Shield that blocks damage up to ATK × {1}%.
en.skill.110015.name: Big Profit!
en.skill.110015.desc.0: Attacks an enemy row with a {1}-hit attack of {0} Power. Also grants self an effect that nullifies the next attack received from an enemy once.
en.skill.110016.name: Nanairo's Garden
en.skill.110016.desc.0: Inflicts Freeze for 3 actions on all enemies. While Frozen, units cannot take any actions. Taking damage removes Freeze, but damage taken at that time is increased by {0}%.
en.skill.110017.name: A Doze Between Acts
en.skill.110017.desc.0: Performs an EN attack of {0} Power on an enemy row and inflicts Burn for 5 actions. Burn deals damage over time equal to ATK × 30%.
en.skill.110018.name: You're Soaking Wet!
en.skill.110018.desc.0: Ignores a single enemy's DEF and Shield, and attacks with {1} Power. If the target's HP is 40% or below, this attack's damage dealt is increased by {0}%.
en.skill.110018.desc.1: Ignores a single enemy's DEF and Shield, and attacks with {1} Power. If the target's HP is 40% or below, damage dealt is increased by {0}%. Also, if this attack defeats the enemy, reduces all enemies' AP by 1 each.
en.skill.110019.name: Stack Overflow
en.skill.110019.desc.0: Attacks a single enemy with {0} Power and inflicts Stun for 1 action.
en.skill.110019.desc.1: Attacks a single enemy with {0} Power and inflicts Stun for 2 actions.
en.skill.110020.name: Black Style
en.skill.110020.desc.0: Performs an EN attack of {0} Power on a single enemy, then distributes the EX Gauge self consumed to activate this skill among all allies except self.
en.skill.110021.name: Scarlet Nail
en.skill.110021.desc.0: Attacks all enemies with {0} Power (cannot be evaded) and inflicts Stun for 1 action on the single enemy with the highest ATK.
en.skill.110021.desc.1: Attacks all enemies with {0} Power (cannot be evaded) and inflicts Stun for 1 action on the single enemy with the highest ATK. Also inflicts a debuff on all enemies that increases damage taken from their next attack by {1}% (stackable).
en.skill.110022.name: Hiiragi Campus Honor Student
en.skill.110022.desc.0: Targets the enemy with the lowest HP% and attacks the enemy row that contains it with {0} Power. If the target survives the attack, attacks it again with {1} Power.
en.skill.110023.name: Checkmate
en.skill.110023.desc.0: Attacks all enemies with {0} Power and removes up to 3 buffs from the targets.
en.skill.110023.desc.1: Attacks all enemies with {0} Power and removes up to 3 buffs from the targets. Also grants all allies a buff that nullifies ailments for 2 actions.
en.skill.110024.name: SLAAAAASH！！！

ai.memoria.10001.name: Shopping with the Three of Them
ai.memoria.10001.quote: Yay♪ Then I won't hold back! A parfait shop, pancakes, a steakhouse... I'm going to all of them!
ai.memoria.10002.name: Memories of a Group Photo
ai.memoria.10002.quote:
Oh, right, that reminds me. Let me show you something nice.
This is a photo we had taken right after we formed. See, see? Isn't it cute?
ai.memoria.10003.name: How to Stop the Brutal Training?
ai.memoria.10003.quote:
Mmm, you're sooo soft~, squish squish squish~.
Kyah! Nn, uuu...! Ch-Chiyuru-san...
ai.memoria.10004.name: The Bonds of Pre-Class A
ai.memoria.10004.quote: We did it, we did it! We won! We really won! Yeah! Everyone worked so hard! We did it! I'm so glad I'm on this team!
ai.memoria.10005.name: Where the Misunderstanding Leads
ai.memoria.10005.quote: ...An explanation... No, it's not an ordinary haunted house. It's a House of Terror. Heart-pounding, a little hardcore, and with a shock at the very end.
ai.memoria.10006.name: Cooking and Girl Talk for Two
ai.memoria.10006.quote:
I'll feed you! Here, this one! Say "ahh"!
Wh-whoa! S-Sumika-san, you're so bold...! Feeding someone like that...!
ai.memoria.10007.name: Helping-Out Stroll
ai.memoria.10007.quote:
I want to help with everyone's wishes
and make them smile. Everyone's smiles feel so warm and cozy.
ai.memoria.10008.name: Cuilan Is Julia's...
ai.memoria.10008.quote:
...I'm fine...
However... how long do you intend to keep groping, you pervert?
ai.memoria.10009.name: Year-End Reflections
ai.memoria.10009.quote:
Heh... I rarely go to karaoke with anyone.
It came back to me, and I found myself stopping in my tracks.
ai.memoria.10010.name: Christmas Surprise♪
ai.memoria.10010.quote:
Cuilan-chan said a present for the Commander should be the thing you most want to give!
So I'm giving you me~♪
ai.memoria.10011.name: The Past That Led to Chaos
ai.memoria.10011.quote:
This team, Chaos Maiden... before I knew it,
it had become a precious place that accepts me even knowing who I am.
ai.memoria.10012.name: Visiting the Places of a You I Never Knew
ai.memoria.10012.quote:
Instead of having everyone learn everything at once,
I'll show everyone the "real" me of today, little by little—
ai.memoria.10013.name: The Snowy Mountain's Other Rumor
ai.memoria.10013.quote:
There are still so many sights I have yet to see.
When that time comes... well, might I accompany you?
ai.memoria.10014.name: Proof of Effort
ai.memoria.10014.quote:
Because you judged that I have the ability
worthy of Arcturus.
ai.memoria.10015.name: Something Tugging at Her Memory
ai.memoria.10015.quote:
I'd like to know more about MGs.
They're very similar to Tactical Surface Fighters, but there seem to be plenty of differences.
ai.memoria.10016.name: Klutzy Committee Chair
ai.memoria.10016.quote:
I really am hopeless, aren't I...
I meant to help someone, and I ended up being the one who needed helping...
ai.memoria.10017.name: Live Mode
ai.memoria.10017.quote:
Yes, this is far better than I imagined.
Each of you shows your own personality, and it suits you all very well.
ai.memoria.10018.name: 3000x Sensitivity Slippery Sumo
ai.memoria.10018.quote: "3000x Sensitivity Slippery Lotion" on sale now! Born from the antics of two girls who met in the sea of the internet, this new product is best tried in a maidens' sumo bout.
ai.memoria.10019.name: The Maid Detectives Chase an Academy Mystery
ai.memoria.10019.quote:
Hyaah! Got you, you crook!
Give back what you stole from everyone!
ai.memoria.10020.name: Even If I Pile Lies on My Loneliness
ai.memoria.10020.quote:
If I win, how about you whisper "I love you" in my ear,
with all your heart!
ai.memoria.10021.name: Come, Let Me Pamper You
ai.memoria.10021.quote:
Everyone demands far too much of you, dear.
No one will fault you for resting now and then.
ai.memoria.10022.name: If It's Shared with You
ai.memoria.10023.name: Inter-Academy Mahjong Tournament
ai.memoria.10023.quote: The tournament is for pairs! I'll do the winning, so you just sit there!
ai.memoria.10024.name: Most Wanted: "Dark Drug"
ai.memoria.10024.quote: Mao: "Carina! Here's the composite sketch!" Carina: "...Nice one, Chair~!"
ai.memoria.10025.name: The Unknown Her of an Unknown World
ai.memoria.10025.quote: I hardly ever wear stuff like this, so you'd better burn it into your eyes while you can~?
ai.memoria.10026.name: A Secret from Zina
ai.memoria.10026.quote: Wha—!? Are you still angry about being dragged in earlier!? Elena shares the blame for always being where I ran to...!
ai.memoria.10027.name: Dieting for Someone Else
ai.memoria.10027.quote: The grilled squid is rich and tasty too...! This chewiness is irresisti— ah, it's already gone...!?
ai.memoria.10028.name: I Tried a Beach Date♪
ai.memoria.10028.quote: I'm here for the water sports tournament, but there's a bit of a wait, so I'll tour the beach huts and show you their top picks~!
ai.memoria.10029.name: From the Me Who Was Once a Child
ai.memoria.10029.quote:
Wah, waah!? Hey, you can't both pull at the same time!?
Sensei, I'll get torn in two!
ai.memoria.20001.name: A Study Session for Two
ai.memoria.20001.quote: Um... I... I've been wondering if there's something more I can do for everyone in Sirius Sugar...
ai.memoria.20002.name: A World I've Yet to Know
ai.memoria.20002.quote:
If I will do, I'd be delighted.
Allow me to explain how to care for flowers, from the very basics.
ai.memoria.20005.name: The Me I Want You to Know
ai.memoria.20005.quote:
I like silver things. They're cute.
It's a calm color... and it goes with my hair, too.
ai.memoria.20006.name: Strictness and Kindness
ai.memoria.20006.quote:
Some people hate me and speak ill of me.
But if being the villain lets me protect everyone, I'll gladly be hated as much as it takes.
ai.memoria.20007.name: The Praise-Hungry Type
ai.memoria.20007.quote:
Ah... h-h-hello! I-I've been waiting for you!!
I thought if I waited outside your room, you'd come out eventually...
ai.memoria.20008.name: Plan Your Gratitude Wisely
ai.memoria.20008.quote:
Shaddaaap!! Don't say that name!!
Did you look inside my planner!? Did you or didn't you!?
ai.memoria.20009.name: The Best Me I Want to Show
ai.memoria.20009.quote:
H-hey! What are you laughing at!?
I-I'll wipe that grin off your face someday, just you wait!
ai.memoria.20010.name: A Date, My Way
ai.memoria.20010.quote: Hearing it all at once would be a waste, right? ...So I'll ask you on another date someday. Tell me the rest then, nice and slow, okay?
ai.memoria.20011.name: Your Dangerous Feelings
ai.memoria.20011.quote:
These air guns are all the rage right now!
You move around a lot, so it's good training for piloting too.
ai.memoria.20012.name: The Pillar of Chaos Maiden
ai.memoria.20012.quote:
Honestly... you're hopeless.
I'll show you to the exit, so please follow me.
ai.memoria.20013.name: Facing My True Nature
ai.memoria.20013.quote: I must control it even more! This pleasure! This thrill! This elation! So I can make it even more my own!
ai.memoria.20014.name: Where Do Feelings Live?
ai.memoria.20014.quote:
I saw it in the shopping district and thought it was the thing I wanted most.
I usually buy things myself, but having someone buy it for me feels special.
ai.memoria.20015.name: A Lesson for the Troublemaker
ai.memoria.20015.quote:
Please... don't go away...!
Don't leave me behind... don't leave me all alone...!
ai.memoria.20017.name: Fl∞ty's "Poyo"
ai.memoria.20017.quote:
I hate lame behavior, and my friends mean the world to me...
and I just love that free gal vibe nothing can tie down!
ai.memoria.20019.name: What I Really Want to Do
ai.memoria.20019.quote:
I'm going to give it my all at this academy. Because I can make my friends and all kinds of people smile...
Look forward to it, okay? Someday I'll sing for you, Commander.
ai.memoria.20020.name: Your Secret I Want to Know
ai.memoria.20020.quote:
Fashion like this is my hobby, you see♪
I'll put together a proper look for you.
ai.memoria.20021.name: Rosie the Fantasy Sculptor
ai.memoria.20021.quote: C'mon, hur-ry-up. Never mind, never mind, let's hurry back to the room. Giddy-up, Kouhai-kun!
ai.memoria.20022.name: Noblesse Oblige
ai.memoria.20022.quote: The clothes at this shop are wonderful! Look, every one is so cute...! Fufu, just looking at them makes my heart dance.
ai.memoria.20023.name: What a Maid Should Be
ai.memoria.20023.quote:
Haha, doesn't sound like me, huh? Fretting like this.
Sorry for letting you see me so pathetic.
ai.memoria.20024.name: What a Hero Needs!
ai.memoria.20024.quote:
Fighting can't be helped. Even Lilly does it.
But hitting and punching is wrong!
ai.memoria.20025.name: The Me I Should Be, the Me I Want to Be
ai.memoria.20025.quote:
To be won over by someone yet again...
Perhaps I have no talent for being a spy.
ai.memoria.20026.name: For Everyone's Sake
ai.memoria.20026.quote: —Gotcha! Huh? I was sure you were here... Hey, where are you~!? Come o~n!
ai.memoria.20027.name: Who I Am Now
ai.memoria.20027.quote:
That's it, that's it. Run like that and you'll get less tired.
If there's anything you don't get, you can ask me as many times as you like.
ai.memoria.20028.name: A Heartfelt Thank You
ai.memoria.20028.quote: To the Commander, who always looks after us: a delivery of gratitude! Here's to many more years together♪
ai.memoria.20029.name: Poyo-Packed♥ Vampire Gal
ai.memoria.20029.quote: I-I'm only changing clothes, so nothing that drastic is going to happen!
ai.memoria.20031.name: A Diary for Two
ai.memoria.20031.quote:
Relaxing like this is nice too... being with everyone is great, of course.
But I'd like it to be just the two of us again, Takeru-chan.
ai.memoria.20032.name: Memories We Search for Together
ai.memoria.20032.quote:
The view from here... is peace itself.
I do not know this scenery... and yet I feel as if I fought in pursuit of it.
ai.memoria.20033.name: Something We Can Do Together
ai.memoria.20033.quote: Huh? ...This is the plushie they were selling at the variety store...! Takeru-san... this... are you sure? For me to have it...
ai.memoria.20034.name: Reivel's Stand-In Manager
ai.memoria.20034.quote:
I handle basic hair styling and makeup myself.
I make a point of doing what I can on my own.
ai.memoria.20035.name: Operation: Diet for Two!
ai.memoria.20035.quote:
Mmm... munch munch...
Ehehe... yummy... I can't... eat any more...
ai.memoria.20036.name: A Special Feeling
ai.memoria.20036.quote:
Nothing but stars and the moon.
...But the night sky, seen together by the six of us, feels special. A little different.
ai.memoria.20037.name: We Haven't Had a Pillow Fight Yet!
ai.memoria.20037.quote:
Fee-chan, let's settle this~~~~!!
...Just kidding, take that, Anis-chan!
ai.memoria.20038.name: Sharing a Snow-Lit Night
ai.memoria.20038.quote:
Sneaking off to have you all to myself isn't fair, but...
at least for this moment right now, it's okay, right...?
ai.memoria.20039.name: Like a Flickering Flame
ai.memoria.20039.quote:
...It really is beautiful. A candle flickering in the pitch dark.
It's reassuring... or rather, calming.
ai.memoria.20040.name: Twisted Gratitude
ai.memoria.20040.quote:
A weakling like you can't do a thing without Rami around.
Fine, whatever... I'll let you stick with me from now on too.
ai.memoria.20041.name: "Love"
ai.memoria.20041.quote:
Feels all fuzzy...
Onii-chan's head pats are Lydia's number one.
ai.memoria.20044.name: Having a Blast on the Snowy Mountain!
ai.memoria.20044.quote:
Wh-why~!? I practice properly,
and I train all the time too... owwwwww!?
ai.memoria.20045.name: Fever, Humidity, and Nursing
ai.memoria.20045.quote:
As a big sister... I want to show my little brother and sister
how cool I can be.
ai.memoria.20046.name: A Brief Breather
ai.memoria.20046.quote:
I've never seen a noodle dish like this.
Just looking at it makes me excited!
ai.memoria.20047.name: Lucie's Landing
ai.memoria.20047.quote:
...Haah, honestly.
I'll look after you until you don't need me anymore.
ai.memoria.20048.name: Stride of Remembrance
ai.memoria.20048.quote:
Wake up, Shirogane!
It's long past the time we agreed on!
ai.memoria.20049.name: A Continue for Two
ai.memoria.20049.quote:
Takeru's going to be amazed too! Okay, watch!
First you pass the string from back to front like this...
ai.memoria.20050.name: Yakisoba Bread Rhapsody
ai.memoria.20050.quote: Great as field rations too. Tasty even cold. Perfect.
ai.memoria.20051.name: Our Joint Effort
ai.memoria.20051.quote:
In a way, this outfit is more embarrassing than being naked,
so at first I was shocked and thought it had to be a mistake...
ai.memoria.20052.name: I'm All Right Now
ai.memoria.20052.quote:
In real combat, there's no time to hesitate...
I have to learn to use it well while I still can.
ai.memoria.20053.name: Clumsy Kindness
ai.memoria.20053.quote:
You have nowhere to go, right?
Then I'll make a "place to go" for you.
ai.memoria.20054.name: My First Selfish Wish
ai.memoria.20054.quote:
That's the first time I've ever asked for something selfish.
I guess I really could have said it sooner, couldn't I...?
ai.memoria.20055.name: A Hurdle to Clear
ai.memoria.20055.quote:
...Just like Justion changed Lilly,
I want to lead that person somewhere better.
ai.memoria.20056.name: A Rule-Breaking Illustration
ai.memoria.20056.quote:
Carina: "You're good at drawing~. So this is how people see me and the Chair, huh."
Mao: "Lewd things are a rule violation! Wait, why are you uploading it without asking!?"
ai.memoria.20057.name: Pico Wrote It Up Neatly!
ai.memoria.20057.quote: Master! I wrote it up neatly for you~!
ai.memoria.20058.name: The Vice-Chair's Real Self?
ai.memoria.20058.quote:
Most of the time, you slack off pro-per-ly,
and when it counts you go bam and shine. That's good enough.
ai.memoria.20059.name: The Forgotten Words That Started It All
ai.memoria.20059.quote:
I-I'm sorry! For causing you trouble...
Um, if you move around too much... th-that's...
ai.memoria.20060.name: Betting My Feelings
ai.memoria.20060.quote:
If the alternative is causing you trouble,
I'll take on a match like this myself.
ai.memoria.20061.name: The Lost Little Bunny
ai.memoria.20061.quote:
We didn't both need to squeeze into
the same locker, did we...
ai.memoria.20062.name: With Father...
ai.memoria.20062.quote:
Um... well... that is...
...I'm sorry. I couldn't talk much.
ai.memoria.20063.name: Bear-Eared Mother and Beloved Daughter
ai.memoria.20063.quote:
At my daughter's request, I've transformed into "Grizzly Moon."
—In the name of the bear, I'll punish you.
ai.memoria.20064.name: A Nervous Performance
ai.memoria.20064.quote:
Right now, I'm not Harriet...
I'm not Harriet, so there's nothing to be embarrassed about...
ai.memoria.20065.name: Because I Don't Want Any Regrets
ai.memoria.20065.quote:
I don't want any regrets! Kay and Harry.
I don't want to leave anything undone with the friends who've become so dear to me!
ai.memoria.20066.name: Someday, I'll Be Your Sword
ai.memoria.20066.quote:
"Upon this sword, I shall strike down all that would harm you.
Upon this heart, I shall remain at your side."
ai.memoria.20067.name: Overlaid with Memories
ai.memoria.20067.quote: Ah, oh, no... my apologies. I'm not used to... the product names of this world.
ai.memoria.20068.name: My Day as a Proper Young Lady
ai.memoria.20068.quote: What do you mean, "loud"!? I just... changed my mind a little, that's all!
ai.memoria.20069.name: A Dreamlike Ending
ai.memoria.20069.quote: Behave yourself. ...I don't want to get any rougher than this.
ai.memoria.20070.name: The Violator's Selfie
ai.memoria.20073.name: Captivated by a Side I'd Never Seen
ai.memoria.20073.quote: P-please stop! Bringing up embarrassing stories from so long ago that even I don't remember them!
ai.memoria.20074.name: As Long As I'm Dancing with You
ai.memoria.20074.quote: Fufu... dancing isn't a contest, so there's no winning or losing, you know?
ai.memoria.20075.name: Let Us Pamper Each Other
ai.memoria.20075.quote: You did well... I was watching over you the whole time, dear one...
ai.memoria.20076.name: You, Who See Me
ai.memoria.20076.quote: Phew... my, my, you're really stiff, customer♪ Rock solid! Now this is worth showing off my skills!
ai.memoria.20077.name: With Kindness in Her Eyes
ai.memoria.20077.quote: ...So, Carina, I'll leave the rest to you. No more slacking off, okay?
ai.memoria.20078.name: Reaching for the Radiance
ai.memoria.20078.quote: Do I... even have the right to be with all of you?
ai.memoria.20079.name: Dreaming Is Free
ai.memoria.20079.quote: On my next diet, I'll definitely slim down big time...! No, all at once is hard, so maybe the diet after that...
ai.memoria.20080.name: My Most Precious Thing
ai.memoria.20080.quote: My, just where exactly are you planning to touch? How sca~ry... fufu♪
ai.memoria.20081.name: Even on a Day Full of Trouble
ai.memoria.20081.quote: Wa-wa-wa, what do I... do!? Ah, ah... eh!? Aaaaah~~~!?
ai.memoria.20082.name: Helping-Out Stroll and a Summer Treasure
ai.memoria.20082.quote: Reivel, Luna, Onii-chan... and Lydia. Being all together is surely the best treasure.
ai.memoria.20083.name: Coffee, and Memories...
ai.memoria.20083.quote:
Wanting this place to stay lively and keep going
is also my way of repaying a kindness♪
ai.memoria.20084.name: The Business Circle I Dream Of
ai.memoria.20084.quote:
As that circle grows, in the end everyone is smiling...
That kind of business is my dream.
ai.memoria.20085.name: So We All Win Together
ai.memoria.20085.quote: U-um... I'm fairly sure I hung the "In Use" sign...
ai.memoria.20086.name: First Feelings
ai.memoria.20086.quote:
Ahaha♪ From here on, I'm getting serious too!
Let's be rivals, everyone!
ai.memoria.20088.name: Muv-Luv GG Collab Café Celebration!
ai.memoria.20088.quote:
Meru: "Welcome, Commander! Please eat lots!"
Rami: "Getting waited on by Rami and the girls? Talk about super lucky. Go on, cry tears of joy~?"
ai.memoria.30006.name: A Fateful Meeting with the Girls
ai.memoria.30006.quote:
U-um, are you all right? I'm glad you've woken up...
...S-so, um... for now, here's a towel.
ai.memoria.30007.name: A Hard Warm-Up...?
ai.memoria.30007.quote: Nn, ah, haah, haah... nnuuuuu! No, ah, I-I can't... any more...!
ai.memoria.30008.name: The Incognito Sister's Adventure
ai.memoria.30008.quote: Because I'm too scared to move...! Please, I beg you, stay by my side...!
ai.memoria.30009.name: Intriguing Equipment
ai.memoria.30009.quote: ...Fufufu... it's all squishy...♪ This is... interesting. Addictive. Don't mind if I do... poke, poke.
ai.memoria.30011.name: We Tried a L*wd Punishment Game
ai.memoria.30011.quote:
Haah... haah... p-please don't film Flute
looking like this so much~...!
ai.memoria.30012.name: Full-Throttle Elopement!
ai.memoria.30012.quote:
My, Commander... fufu, how bold of you.
Did you want to see us naked that badly?
ai.memoria.30013.name: The Timid Reindeer's Holy Night
ai.memoria.30013.quote:
A-a naughty reindeer!?
Wh-wha, no way, th-that's...!
ai.memoria.30014.quote: A team of gifted members led by Reivel. They regard a three-member lineup as the optimal formation.
ai.memoria.30015.name: New Year's at the Momozono House
ai.memoria.30015.quote:
Mmm~, Mom's black beans really are the best~!
Mom! Teach me this black bean recipe later!
ai.memoria.30016.name: New Year's Greetings
ai.memoria.30016.quote:
Happy New Year. I will devote myself to making Zartum Academy even better.
I would be grateful for your continued support this year.
ai.memoria.30017.name: Up Close!? Chaos in the Tent
ai.memoria.30017.quote:
Ahaha! This might be fun! Come on, come on!
Push, push, no crying if you get squished!
ai.memoria.30018.name: Hospitality from Three Maids?
ai.memoria.30018.quote:
Don't you "what's going on" me!
You pervert! Brute! Peeping tom! Scoundrel!!
ai.memoria.30019.name: Old Rivals Stuck Together?
ai.memoria.30019.quote: Sakaki is all health-consciousness and no actual health. Getting angry so easily proves it.
ai.memoria.30020.name: Gripes and Worries
ai.memoria.30020.quote:
How can you expect perfection in so little time!?
You're sure great at spouting complaints and demands!
ai.memoria.30021.name: To You, Who Will Walk with Me from Now On
ai.memoria.30021.quote:
Whenever I look back, you're there, Commander... that gives me the most courage.
I'm counting on you from here on, too!
ai.memoria.30022.name: A Doze Amid the Bustle
ai.memoria.30022.quote:
Photos... go through the staff...
zzz... you're banned...
ai.memoria.30023.name: Euro Tower for a Day
ai.memoria.30023.quote:
What are you doing!? I never said you could stop!
Three minutes, starting now! Keep doing push-ups until you hit your limit!
ai.memoria.30025.name: Absolute Command Rights!
ai.memoria.30025.quote: Come on, place your bets, place your bets! There you go~! Let's keep 'em coming!
ai.memoria.30026.name: Chaos Maiden Twintail Festival♡
ai.memoria.30026.quote:
Now we all match♪ Let's go show the Commander like this♪
I'm sure he'll praise us in a way that moves us♪
ai.memoria.30027.name: Shaping What a Family Looks Like
ai.memoria.30027.quote:
Olga: "State your view, keeping in mind the differences between fighting MGs and fighting Maze Shifters."
Nadya: "Y-yes!"
ai.memoria.30028.name: The Alley Cat with Panties in Its Mouth
ai.memoria.30028.quote:
Haah... if it were just an interview and I didn't actually have to be in the spotlight,
it'd be fine. But a photo shoot, and being in the school magazine...
ai.memoria.30029.name: The Color of the Heart
ai.memoria.30029.quote: ...I never knew a night without being at Inia's side could be this cold...
ai.memoria.30031.name: Etiquette Lessons from a True Young Lady
ai.memoria.30031.quote: Who are you calling Mama... Now, Chiyuru-san. Would you raise your hand a little higher?
ai.memoria.30032.name: Pico's Always by Your Side♪
ai.memoria.30032.quote: Masterrr! This is such a happy occasion! I hope happy things like this keep going fore~ver!
ai.memoria.30033.name: A Soothing Scent
ai.memoria.30033.quote: I knew it... when Mother is with everyone from Krasna, she seems strict, but somehow she also seems at ease...
ai.memoria.30034.name: Why She's in Such High Spirits
ai.memoria.30034.quote: Ahaha, at a glance it just looks like string, huh. But it's a proper swimsuit too~
ai.memoria.30035.name: Something Friends Would Do
ai.memoria.30035.quote:
"Over here, Meru-chan! Let's go, let's go!"
"Wah! Julia-san, please calm down...!"
ai.memoria.30036.name: The World Now Draws a New Path
ai.memoria.30036.quote:
When they smile afterwards and tell me it felt good,
that alone makes me really happy.
ai.memoria.30037.name: To Seize the Future
ai.memoria.30037.quote:
The bonds we've woven gather at the final battlefield.
The time has come to overturn our destined fate and break the "Garden."
ai.memoria.30038.name: The Greatest Fortune Is...
ai.memoria.30038.quote:
Mm... just soaking in the tub
warms my whole body up. It feels so nice...

- 4 or more: this attack's damage dealt is increased by 50%
ai.skill.120137.desc.0:

chat_sonnet.char.132.description: A girl who calls herself a "Knight" that they met inside the Maze. She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG called a "Tactical Surface Fighter." Relentlessly positive and never discouraged. She's unusually assertive and fussy, but only toward her childhood friend, Takeru Shirogane.
chat_sonnet.char.133.description: A girl who calls herself a "Knight" that they met inside the Maze. She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG called a "Tactical Surface Fighter." Skilled with a sword, extremely dignified and calm. It's said — or perhaps not — that back home she was said to resemble a certain person of noble standing.
chat_sonnet.char.134.description: A girl who calls herself a "Knight" that they met inside the Maze. She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG called a "Tactical Surface Fighter." Always cheerful and innocent. Friendly by nature. Takeru Shirogane calls her by the nickname "Tama." Exceptionally skilled at sniping.
chat_sonnet.char.135.description: A girl who calls herself a "Knight" that they met inside the Maze. She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG called a "Tactical Surface Fighter." A soldierly personality who values discipline and following orders. She doesn't seem to get along with the free-spirited Ayamine.
chat_sonnet.char.136.description: A girl who calls herself a "Knight" that they met inside the Maze. She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG called a "Tactical Surface Fighter." Extremely cheerful by nature, sometimes serving as the squad's mood-maker, but she can be so laid-back that she often isn't really listening to what people say.
chat_sonnet.char.137.description: A girl who calls herself a "Knight" that they met inside the Maze. She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG called a "Tactical Surface Fighter." She's rather like a cat. Highly skilled in close combat, she fights adaptably as the situation demands — though sometimes that adaptability tips over into acting on her own judgment.
chat_sonnet.char.143.description: Leader of Krasna. A veteran with over ten years of piloting experience, and also a mother raising a daughter on her own. A strict person who values discipline and prioritizes rationality. She rarely shows emotion, but her deep love for her daughter, though awkwardly expressed, is genuine.
chat_sonnet.char.144.hobby: Keeping a diary (never shows it to anyone)
chat_sonnet.char.144.description: Olga's only daughter. Withdrawn and rather spoiled by nature. She's also a hard worker, putting in daily effort to earn her mother's praise. Coming from a single-parent household, she has a longing for the idea of a father. Despite appearances, she inherited real talent from her mother and has excellent MG piloting skill.
chat_sonnet.char.144.favorite: Obeying her mother, sweet food, family time together
chat_sonnet.char.145.description: Krasna's mood-maker. Cheerful and lively, and skilled at reading the room. Her skill as a pilot falls a step behind the other members, but she excels at keeping the team coordinated with each other.
chat_sonnet.char.145.favorite: Other people's smiles, cute stationery and notebooks
chat_sonnet.char.146.hobby: Collecting all kinds of tea leaves
chat_sonnet.char.146.description: Krasna's tactical advisor. Valued for her strong strategic planning ability, which is what got her recruited onto the team. At a glance she seems like a purely rational type devoted to analysis and thinking things through, but she's deeply caring and looks out for her comrades. Her old-fashioned way of speaking comes from the influence of a woman who was once her mentor.
chat_sonnet.char.148.description: A girl who calls herself a "Knight" that they met inside the Maze. She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG called a "Tactical Surface Fighter." Usually strict and disciplined with herself, but every now and then she shows a glimpse of an age-appropriate, girlish side.
chat_sonnet.char.149.description: A girl who calls herself a "Knight" that they met inside the Maze. She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG called a "Tactical Surface Fighter." Quick to pick a fight, in Tactical Surface Fighter combat she excels at close-quarters combat using maneuvers of her own invention.
chat_sonnet.char.150.description: A girl who calls herself a "Knight" that they met inside the Maze. She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG called a "Tactical Surface Fighter." A cool beauty with an air of adult allure. She also has a homely side, sometimes cooking dishes from her homeland for others.
chat_sonnet.char.154.hobby: Looking for things she's never tried before
chat_sonnet.char.154.description: Boss of the illegal pilot organization Double-Headed Axe. In truth, she is an isomeric clone of the original Kagura Shiouten, who has been secretly working to free the world from the control of the "AIDA Protocol Control AI, Izanami." She seems strong-willed at a glance, but at heart she's a kind person who cares for others.
chat_sonnet.char.155.hobby: Reciting military songs, war poems, and heroic epics; tactical simulation games
chat_sonnet.char.155.description: Her alternate personality is Zina Mishina. A member of Krasna, she's a girl with dual personalities. She has a distinctive, somewhat theatrical way of speaking. Combat while piloting an MG is mainly handled by Zina. According to them, they share memories with each other even while switching personalities.

chat_ds.char.132.description: A girl who calls herself a 'Guardian' encountered inside the Maze. She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG called a 'Tactical Machine'. She has a positive personality that never gives up on anything. She is only unusually strong-willed and meddlesome toward her childhood friend Shirogane Takeru.
chat_ds.char.133.description: A girl who calls herself a 'Guardian' encountered inside the Maze. She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG called a 'Tactical Machine'. She excels at swordsmanship and is extremely noble and calm. It is said, or not said, that in her homeland she was said to resemble a certain noble person.
chat_ds.char.134.description: A girl who calls herself a 'Guardian' encountered inside the Maze. She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG called a 'Tactical Machine'. She is always bright and innocent. She has a friendly personality. Shirogane Takeru calls her by the nickname 'Tama'. Her sniping skill is extremely excellent.
chat_ds.char.135.description: A girl who calls herself a 'Guardian' encountered inside the Maze. She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG called a 'Tactical Machine'. She has a soldier-like personality that values discipline and orders. She apparently doesn't get along with the free-spirited Ayamine.
chat_ds.char.136.description: A girl who calls herself a 'Guardian' encountered inside the Maze. She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG called a 'Tactical Machine'. Her personality is extremely bright, and she sometimes serves as the mood maker of the squad, but she is so much on her own pace that she often isn't listening to others.
chat_ds.char.137.description: A girl who calls herself a 'Guardian' encountered inside the Maze. She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG called a 'Tactical Machine'. Her appearance is just like a cat. She has excellent close-quarters combat sense and fights adaptively. Sometimes her adaptability goes too far and becomes acting on her own judgment.
chat_ds.char.143.description: The leader of Krasna. A veteran with over 10 years of pilot experience, and also a mother with one daughter. A strict person who values discipline and prioritizes rationality. She rarely shows emotions, but her deep love for her daughter, though clumsy, is genuine.
chat_ds.char.144.hobby: Keeping a diary (showing it to no one)
chat_ds.char.144.description: Olga's only daughter. She is introverted and has a spoiled-child temperament. She is also a hard worker who accumulates daily effort to be praised by her mother. chat_ds.char.146.description: The tactical strategist of Krasna. Her high strategic planning ability is evaluated, and she joined the team for that ability. At first glance she seems the rational type who devotes herself to analysis and thought, but she is deeply emotional and caring toward her comrades. Her old-fashioned way of speaking is due to the influence of her teacher, a woman.

chat_ds.char.149.description: A girl who calls herself a "Guardian" encountered inside the Maze. She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG called a "Tactical Machine". She has a quick temper and excels at close-quarters combat using her own original maneuvers in Tactical Machine battles.
chat_ds.char.150.description: A girl who calls herself a "Guardian" encountered inside the Maze. She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG called a "Tactical Machine". A cool beauty with the allure of maturity. She also has a domestic side, sometimes serving dishes from her homeland.

A positive and unfazed personality in everything. Only towards his childhood friend, Takeshi Shirogane, is he extremely bullish and obtrusive.
google.char.133.description: A girl who calls herself a ``guard'' whom I met inside Maze. He rides a humanoid weapon similar to an MG called a ``tactical aircraft''. He excels in swordsmanship and is extremely noble and calm. It is said that in his hometown he was said to resemble a certain noble person.
google.char.134.description: A girl who calls herself a ``guard'' whom I met inside Maze. He rides a humanoid weapon similar to an MG called a ``tactical aircraft''. Always bright and innocent. Friendly personality. Takeshi Shirogane calls her by the nickname "Tama". His sniping skills are extremely good.
google.char.135.description: A girl who calls herself a ``guard'' whom I met inside Maze. He rides a humanoid weapon similar to an MG called a ``tactical aircraft''. He has a military-like personality that values ​​discipline and orders. It seems that the free-spirited Ayamine doesn't get along well with her.
google.char.136.description: A girl who calls herself a ``guard'' whom I met inside Maze. He rides a humanoid weapon similar to an MG called a ``tactical aircraft''. He has an extremely bright personality and is sometimes responsible for setting the mood for the squad, but he often goes at his own pace and doesn't listen to what others are saying.
google.char.137.description: A girl who calls herself a ``guard'' whom I met inside Maze. He rides a humanoid weapon similar to an MG called a ``tactical aircraft''. It looks just like a cat. He has an excellent sense of close combat and fights flexibly. Sometimes I get too flexible and end up making my own decisions.
google.char.143.hobby: Handicrafts (such as mending my daughter's clothes)
google.char.143.description: Leader of Krasna. She is a veteran pilot with over 10 years of experience and is also the mother of one daughter. A strict person who values ​​discipline and prioritizes rationality. He rarely shows his emotions, but despite his clumsiness, his deep love for his daughter is genuine.
google.char.144.hobby: Keep a diary (don't show it to anyone)
google.char.144.description: Olga's only daughter. She is shy and has a spoiled personality. She is also a hard worker who works hard every day to earn her mother's praise. Since he is a single-parent family, he yearns for a father. Although he looks like this, he is a talented person inherited from his mother, and has a high level of MG operation skills.
google.char.144.favorite: Obedience to mother, sweet food, family togetherness
google.char.145.description: Krasna's mood maker. He has a bright and energetic personality and is good at reading the atmosphere around him. Although his ability as a pilot lags behind the other members, he is excellent at coordinating with other members.
google.char.145.favorite: Other people's smiles, cute stationery and memo pads
google.char.146.description: Krasna's operational staff. He is highly praised for his ability to plan strategies, and his ability is recognized and he joins the team. At first glance, he seems like a rational type who concentrates on analysis and thinking, but he is also very affectionate and cares about his friends. Her old-fashioned tone is due to the influence of her female teacher.
google.char.148.description: A girl who calls herself a ``guard'' whom I met inside Maze. He rides a humanoid weapon similar to an MG called a ``tactical aircraft''. Although she usually disciplines herself strictly, she also shows glimpses of a girlish side that is appropriate for her age.
google.char.149.description: A girl who calls herself a ``guard'' whom I met inside Maze. He rides a humanoid weapon similar to an MG called a ``tactical aircraft''. He has a quick fighting personality, and is good at close quarters combat using his unique maneuvers in tactical aircraft combat.
google.char.150.description: A girl who calls herself a ``guard'' whom I met inside Maze. He rides a humanoid weapon similar to an MG called a ``tactical aircraft''. Cool beauty with the scent of adult charm. Sometimes there is a homely side to them, such as serving dishes from their home country.
google.char.154.hobby: Looking for something you've never eaten before
google.char.154.description: The boss of the illegal pilot organization Double-Headed Ax. Its true identity is an isotope of the original Kagura Shiouten who was working behind the scenes to liberate the world from the control of the AIDA Protocol Supervising AI Izanami. At first glance, he has a winning personality, but at heart he is a kind person who cares about others.

google.char.155.description: Alternate personality Gina Mishina. A member of Krasna and a girl with a dual personality. He has a unique personality and speaks in a slightly theatrical tone.
